name: Welcome new visitor
title: Friendly greeting with clear next steps.
content:
**Welcome, {{user_name}} 👋**
Thanks for visiting {{company_name}}. I can help you get started or point you to the right product guide.

name: Product tour invite
title: Invite visitors to explore key features.
content: Hi {{user_name}}! Want a quick 2-minute tour of {{company_name}}? I'll show you the features most customers use first.

name: Getting started checklist
title: Share a short first-session checklist.
content:
Hi {{user_name}},
Here's a short checklist to get the most out of {{company_name}}:
- Complete your profile
- Save a delivery address
- Turn on order notifications

name: Trial follow-up
title: Guide visitors after trial activation.
content: Hi {{user_name}}, your trial is active! Reply here any time if you'd like help setting things up.

name: Setup help offer
title: Offer hands-on help during setup.
content: Hi {{user_name}}, I noticed you're setting up your account. Would you like me to walk you through it?

name: Refund approved
title: Confirm an approved refund with timing.
content: Hi {{user_name}}, I've reviewed the return for order {{order_id}} and approved a refund of {{refund_amount}}. You'll see it on your original payment method within 24 hours.

name: Refund delay apology
title: Apologise and commit to a follow-up time.
content: Hi {{user_name}}, I'm sorry your refund for {{order_id}} is taking longer than expected. I've escalated case {{case_id}} and will update you by {{follow_up_time}}.

name: Delivery delay update
title: Share a new delivery estimate.
content: Hi {{user_name}}, your order {{order_id}} was delayed at the courier hub. The new estimated delivery date is {{delivery_date}}. I'll keep an eye on it for you.

name: Replacement shipped
title: Confirm a replacement is on the way.
content:
Hi {{user_name}},
Good news: a replacement for order {{order_id}} has shipped by express delivery. You don't need to return the original item.

name: Return label sent
title: Send a prepaid return label.
content:
Hi {{user_name}},
Your prepaid return label for order {{order_id}} is attached. Drop the parcel at any partner location within 14 days.

name: Order confirmation resend
title: Resend an order confirmation.
content: Hi {{user_name}}, I've resent the confirmation for order {{order_id}} to your email address.

name: Duplicate charge reversed
title: Explain a reversed duplicate charge.
content: Hi {{user_name}}, I've reversed the duplicate charge on order {{order_id}}. The hold will disappear from your statement within 3 business days.

name: Invoice copy
title: Send a copy of an invoice.
content:
Hi {{user_name}},
As requested, a copy of your invoice for order {{order_id}} is attached.

name: Payment failed, retry
title: Help a customer retry a failed payment.
content: Hi {{user_name}}, your payment for {{company_name}} didn't go through. You can retry securely from the app in under a minute.

name: Plan price change notice
title: Explain an upcoming plan price change.
content:
Hi {{user_name}},
From next month your plan price changes. Nothing changes until then, and you can switch plans at any time.

name: Subscription pause offer
title: Offer a pause before cancelling.
content: Hi {{user_name}}, before you cancel: you can pause your subscription for up to 3 months and keep your history. Would that help?

name: Feedback request
title: Ask for feedback after resolution.
content:
Hi {{user_name}},
Thanks for contacting {{company_name}}. Could you take 30 seconds to tell us how we did on case {{case_id}}?

name: Loyalty thank-you
title: Thank long-standing customers.
content: Thank you for being with {{company_name}}, {{user_name}}! We've added a small thank-you credit to your account.

name: Win-back offer
title: Re-engage a lapsed customer.
content:
Hi {{user_name}},
We miss you at {{company_name}}. Here's 15% off your next order, valid for 30 days.

name: Supervisor introduction
title: Introduce yourself when taking over.
content: Hi {{user_name}}, I'm {{agent_name}}, a supervisor at {{company_name}}. I've read the full conversation on case {{case_id}} and I'm taking care of this personally.

name: Escalation acknowledged
title: Reassure the customer after escalation.
content: Thanks for your patience, {{user_name}}. Your case {{case_id}} is now with our senior team and you'll hear back within {{follow_up_time}}.

name: Account unlocked
title: Confirm restored account access.
content: Hi {{user_name}}, I've verified your identity and unlocked your account. Please reset your password with the link we just emailed you.

name: Identity verification steps
title: Explain how to verify identity.
content:
Hi {{user_name}},
To protect your account we need to verify your identity. Reply with the last 4 digits of your payment card and your billing postcode.

name: Closing check-in
title: Wrap up and check nothing is missing.
content: Is there anything else I can help you with today, {{user_name}}? If not, have a great day!

name: Lost parcel investigation
title: Open a courier investigation and set expectations.
content: Hi {{user_name}}, I'm sorry your parcel for order {{order_id}} hasn't arrived. I've opened an investigation with the courier and you'll hear back by {{follow_up_time}}. If it isn't found, we'll reship or refund, your choice.

name: Warranty replacement offer
title: Offer a replacement or refund under warranty.
content: Hi {{user_name}}, I'm sorry the item stopped working. It's covered by our warranty, so I can ship a free replacement today or refund it in full. Which would you prefer?
